title: 1.9亿次播放：里希特却说像虚构，那他还关心音符位置吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: For me, music often comes out of questions, questions about the world.
segments.zh: 对我来说，音乐常常源于问题，关于世界的问题。

segments.en: It feels like we're at multiple turning points, really, culturally, societally, technologically, on a human level.
segments.zh: 感觉我们正处在多个转折点，文化上、社会上、技术上，以及人类层面上。

segments.en: And I wanted to investigate those things further and to kind of focus on the unknowns and the questions.
segments.zh: 我想进一步探究这些，聚焦于未知和问题。

segments.en: Max Richter, one of the world's most successful living composers on the nature of daylight, 190 million streams.
segments.zh: 马克斯·里希特，全球最成功的在世作曲家之一，《论日光》播放量达1.9亿次。

segments.en: Yeah, those numbers are not something I can really imagine. It sort of feels a bit fictional, really.
segments.zh: 是的，那些数字我实在难以想象，感觉有点虚构。

segments.en: I'm trying to put the notes in the right places on a piece of paper.
segments.zh: 我努力把音符放在纸上正确的位置。

segments.en: I don't really think about what, you know, it might sell.
segments.zh: 我并不怎么考虑它可能卖得如何。

segments.en: And I never really have. Because actually, just getting the notes in the right places on the paper is quite hard.
segments.zh: 我从未真正想过，因为实际上，仅仅把音符放在纸上正确的位置就已经很难了。

segments.en: From Bloomberg Weekend, this is the Michelle Hussein show.
segments.zh: 来自彭博周末，这里是米歇尔·侯赛因秀。

segments.en: Something unusual happens within about the first minute of the conversation you're about to hear.
segments.zh: 在你即将听到的对话开始约一分钟内，会发生一些不寻常的事。

segments.en: It involves all of us as a team taking pretty shameless advantage of having a cult composer with us in the studio
segments.zh: 这需要我们整个团队厚着脸皮，利用工作室里有一位狂热作曲家的优势

segments.en: and getting him to listen to our own show music.
segments.zh: 让他听听我们自己的节目音乐。

segments.en: It's a moment of fun and it happened essentially because all of us were happy to welcome Max Richter.
segments.zh: 这是一个有趣的时刻，本质上是因为我们都很高兴欢迎马克斯·里希特。

segments.en: He's an extraordinarily prolific person with a worldwide following.
segments.zh: 他是一位极其多产的人，拥有全球追随者。
